research_rationale:
EO 13137 (signed 1999-09-15; 64 FR 50733, Federal Register of 1999-09-20, FR Doc. 99-24582) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13137.txt. It further amends EO 12975 (National Bioethics Advisory Commission): section 1 restates section 3 of the parent, section 2 adds a new section 4 (membership of not more than 18, member terms and a Chairperson), and section 3 corrects a cross-reference, renumbers sections 4 through 7 as 5 through 8 and, in section 3(c), changes the termination date in new section 8(b) from October 3, 1999 to October 3, 2001. First end for every clause: the Commission's own fixed sunset. The termination section as written by EO 13046 (62 FR 27685, held Federal Register text) reads in part "shall terminate on October 3, 1999, unless extended by the President prior" to that date; this order's section 3(c) moved the date to October 3, 2001. The Commission therefore terminated on October 3, 2001, recorded inclusive (the exclusive reading, that it ends when that day begins, is the alternative a reviewer should see), unless an extension issued first. A by-number search of the held order texts for the parent, EO 12975, finds EO 13018, EO 13046, EO 13137 and EO 13316 (Federal Register copies, and American Presidency Project copies of 13018, 13046, 13137 and 13316) and EO 14096, which cites the parent only as a standard of ethics for the protection of human subjects; none extends the Commission past October 3, 2001. Every clause rewrites or adds text of the parent, which operated only through the Commission, so each ends with the Commission; the 2026-10-21 report-deadline ruling leaves a clause with its own fixed date unaffected, and the sunset here is a fixed date. Later event after the end: EO 13316 (signed 2003-09-17; 68 FR 55255, Federal Register of 2003-09-23) section 3(b) lists Executive Order 12975, as amended by Executive Orders 13018, 13046 and 13137, among the orders revoked as establishing committees that have terminated or whose work is completed, and section 6 makes it effective September 30, 2003. A by-number search of the held order texts for EO 13137 finds only this order's own Federal Register text; EO 13316 names it in a list that the number pattern does not match and was read directly. The held text is the machine-extracted text layer of the official Federal Register PDF; the PDF page images are not held, so identity (printed number, title, signing date and FR Doc. number) was checked on the text layer against the census register row.
